ios.desc:
Take Control of Your Keyboard with FlexiBoard!
FlexiBoard is the ultimate clipboard manager, auto-paste keyboard, and productivity tool, designed to streamline your workflow. Whether you need to copy, paste, store snippets, or create shortcuts, FlexiBoard has you covered. Say goodbye to repetitive typing and hello to efficiency!

Key Features:
- Advanced Clipboard Manager – Effortlessly copy, paste, and organize text, media, and frequently used content. Never lose important clips again!

- New AI Writing Tools – Paraphrase, summarize, translate, and improve your text in seconds right from your keyboard.

- Auto-Paste & Quick Shortcuts – Speed up your typing with snippets, shortcuts, and auto-paste features. Instantly insert saved text or media with a tap.

- Smart Bookmarks – Save commonly used phrases, templates, and media files for quick access. Perfect for fast replies, notes, and productivity hacks.

- Quick Unit Converter – Instantly convert between units like length, weight, temperature, and more right from your keyboard.

- Built-in Calculator – Perform quick calculations without switching apps. Calculate on the go, right from your keyboard.

- AI Dictionary & Thesaurus – Get smarter, context-aware word meanings and better language help while typing, with instant definitions and synonyms.

- Seamless Calendar View – Check dates and events directly from your keyboard, no need to open a separate calendar app.


Why Choose FlexiBoard?

- Fast & Efficient: Works across all apps, making it the perfect tool for clipboard management, auto-paste, and quick shortcuts.
- Secure & Private: Your data stays on your device—no cloud storage, no tracking.
- Perfect for Productivity: Whether you’re a student, writer, or power user, FlexiBoard helps you work smarter and faster.

Download FlexiBoard today and revolutionize the way you copy, paste, and manage your keyboard!


**TRIAL AND SUBSCRIPTION PLANS**  
FlexiBoard is available for free with optional upgrades. After your 1-week free trial, you can choose the plan that fits your needs:  

**Pro Plan**  
- **Monthly**: $2.99 with a 3-day free trial  
- **Annual**: $11.99 with a 3-day free trial  
- **Lifetime**: $19.99 (one-time payment)  

**Pro + AI Plan**  
- **Weekly**: $1.49  
- **Monthly**: $3.99  
- **Annual**: $29.99

quotes.text:
Hey folks, I wanted to share something I’ve been working on. It's a keyboard extension app I made because I was tired of constantly switching between apps (when applying for jobs) and losing track of the things I copy or save. If you’ve ever juggled between tools trying to stay organized, this might help! Here’s what it does:

  * Clipboard Manager: Keeps track of everything you copy, text, links, and even media files (like images and PDFs). No more frustration over lost copied text or links.  

* Snippets (Bookmarks): Save and organize reusable text, links, or files into folders for quick access. Whether it's email templates, CV, addresses, or frequently used phrases, you can store them neatly and insert them anywhere with just a tap.

  * Calculator: A quick calculator right within the app for all those little math tasks. 

* Dictionary: Instantly look up definitions on the go. Super handy when you're reading or writing.

* Calendar: Check dates fast without opening your calendar app. You can access most of these directly from your iOS keyboard, so you don’t even need to leave the app you’re using.

I built FlexiBoard with privacy in mind. NO DATA is collected and it’s free to download. No sign up needed. There's a pro version, but the free version has almost all the features except saving media files.
